newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil June tax receipts at 8.6 bln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil June tax receipts at 8.6 bln reais.

text.p: Brazilian federal tax receipts were 8.599 billion reais in June, 10.38 percent higher in real terms than the 7.79 billion reais collected in the same month a year ago, the Internal Revenue Service said.
The Internal Revenue Service said in a statement that tax receipts for the January to June period were 53.571 billion reais, a 5.99 percent increase in real terms over the first half of 1996.
In nominal terms, not adjusted for inflation, June's tax receipts were 18.67 percent higher than in June 1996.
As for the first half accumulated tax revenue, it was 15.41 percent higher in nominal terms than the 50.543 billion reais collected in January-June 1996, the statement said.
In May, federal tax receipts amounted to 8.716 billion reais, up 7.42 percent in real terms from the same month last year.
